stem: A teammate proposes backdating a missing movement record using the time they think the move probably occurred. Why is that unacceptable?
choices: Backdating is acceptable whenever totals balance
It creates unsupported audit evidence; the record should reflect verified evidence and the approved correction/escalation process rather than invented details
rationale: Traceability depends on defensible evidence. Inventing a timestamp or operator to make records balance undermines the audit trail and can create compliance problems.
